selection: minimum dev token-mean teacher-forced NLL; earliest epoch including initialization
state_metrics: existing frozen ContextECJMF; masked per-factor T3 on the READY P0 task; not new P1 supervision
loss: response token cross entropy only; frozen context/state model has no optimizer parameters
context_policy: role-marked system head/tail and most-recent delivered history; report truncation; never read messages/target at inference
test_policy: all train/dev selections complete before test; previously exposed source corpus, diagnostic not fresh blind confirmation
latest_user_policy: keep entire latest user interruption, including role boundaries; budget may expand for this turn
budget_scope: Initial CPU adapter training; fixed to 12 epochs before any test scoring. Earlier 40-epoch train-only attempt stopped without outputs.
